custom_commands: usermod -s /usr/bin/fish root && getent passwd | awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $3<65534 {print $1; exit}' | xargs -r -I{} usermod -s /usr/bin/fish {} && sed -i 's|^SHELL=.*|SHELL=/usr/bin/fish|' /etc/default/useradd

U=$(getent passwd | awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $3<65534 {print $1; exit}') && test -n "$U" && mkdir -p /home/$U/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants && ln -sf /usr/lib/systemd/user/syncthing.service /home/$U/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/syncthing.service && chown -R $U:$U /home/$U/.config
U=$(getent passwd | awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $3<65534 {print $1; exit}') && test -n "$U" && usermod -aG docker "$U"

U=$(getent passwd | awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $3<65534 {print $1; exit}') && test -n "$U" && mkdir -p $(dirname /home/$U/bin/opencode.fish) && echo '' | base64 -d > /home/$U/bin/opencode.fish && chmod 755 /home/$U/bin/opencode.fish && mkdir -p $(dirname /home/$U/bin/opencode-1.patch) && echo '' | base64 -d > /home/$U/bin/opencode-1.patch && mkdir -p $(dirname /home/$U/bin/opencode-2.patch) && echo '' | base64 -d > /home/$U/bin/opencode-2.patch && mkdir -p $(dirname /home/$U/bin/opencode-3.patch) && echo '' | base64 -d > /home/$U/bin/opencode-3.patch && chown -R $U:$U /home/$U/bin
